newsitem.title: BELARUS: US firm buys 67 pct of Belarus picture tube maker.
newsitem.headline: US firm buys 67 pct of Belarus picture tube maker.

text.p: Unlisted U.S. manufacturing and distributing company Westray Group is buying 67 percent of Belarus picture tube maker Korall for $24 million, the president's office said on Tuesday.
The government will retain ownership of 33 percent of Korall.
A decree from President Alexander Lukashenko frees Korall from paying duties, value-added tax, and excise tax on machinery and equipment being imported to modernise the factory.
The tubes will be manufactured for local consumption and export.

Westray, which is currently moving its headquarters to Florida from Hong Kong, started off as an engineering contracting company specialising in picture tubes for televisions and computer monitors, but has since diversified into warehousing, shipping and trading.
